name: Raman Baseline-Removal Benchmark Artifacts: Spectrum Pairs, Optimized Parameters, and Method Outputs
description: This record contains the artifact package accompanying the manuscript “Study of the Performance of Various Automated Techniques for Removing the Baseline from Raman Spectra across Different Similarity Metrics”. The archive includes the 2620 paired Raman spectra used in the benchmark, the grouped train/holdout split, parent-group tables, optimized theta* parameter profiles, benchmark summary tables, source-stratified results, statistical figures, timing diagnostics, selected example identifiers, source-citation guidance, and method-output tables organized by optimized theta* profile. The spectrum pairs are organized across five source folders: NASA Raman Database (RAMdb), OpenSpecy, Raman Open Database, RamanSPy, and RRUFF. The archive also includes manifest and checksum files to support file-level verification. Original source databases and software resources should be cited together with this Zenodo record and the associated manuscript.
